description: This file defines a custom assertion class 'CommandResponseAssert' for testing 'CommandResponse' objects, including a nested comparator class for JSON object comparisons. It is used in the context of testing command response objects in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CommandResponseAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class for 'CommandResponse' objects, providing methods for validation and comparison in tests.

classes.name: JsonObjectComparator
classes.description: A private static nested class implementing Comparator<JsonObject> used to compare JsonObjects by ignoring field definitions.

methods.name: CommandResponseAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion object with a specific 'CommandResponse' instance.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Asserts that the actual 'CommandResponse' is equal to the expected one by comparing fields and JSON content.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two 'JsonObject' instances for equality, ignoring field definitions, catching assertion errors for better logging.
